tools.description: Search businesses in Costa Rica (or Panama with country: 'PA', Guatemala with 'GT', the Dominican Republic with 'DO') by industry, category, place, name and contact channel. tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Records how the contact with a revealed business went. wrong_number and closed give the credit back (within 14 days, up to 10% of what was revealed that month) and send the business back to research. Use note 'do not contact' when a business asks not to be written to again.

tools.name: my_contacts
tools.description: The businesses you revealed with their contacts and wa.me links, the last outcome you reported and when the reveal expires (after that the contacts come back masked until revealed again), plus your balance.

tools.description: Credit packs (100 = US$29, 500 = US$119, 2,000 = US$399, 10,000 = US$1,490) with their Stripe payment link. The link carries the client number, so credits load on their own once the payment completes. Give the link to the person as is; Fyrmo never asks for card details here.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_similar" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_list, get_business, match_list · Private data: search_businesses, quote_list, build_list, get_business, find_similar, match_list, reveal_contacts, report_outcome, my_contacts · Public sink: build_list, match_list, reveal_contacts, report_outcome · Destructive: search_businesses, get_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_list, get_business, match_list · Private data: search_businesses, quote_list, build_list, get_business, find_similar, match_list, reveal_contacts, report_outcome, my_contacts · Public sink: build_list, match_list, reveal_contacts, report_outcome · Destructive: search_businesses, get_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
